{{Top|leg}}
'''Shel Marcino''' was one of the few members of the [[Tarnished Blades|Silent Blades]] to survive the assault by [[Vocis Kenit]] and the ''[[Far Orbit]]''. Marcino later he gathered the other survivors and formed the the [[Tarnished Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang.
